text: The US Government brutally laid out the magnitude of the Intel processor vulnerabilities that affect almost everyone (INTC, MSFT, AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, AMZN) By Matt Weinberger Jan 4, 2018, 1:26 pm 5 pts On Wednesday, Google and Intel disclosed "Meltdown" and "Spectre," two ways to exploit Intel, AMD, and ARM processors and get access to confidential data.
